page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so each line stops mid-word at the edge; those words are completed only where the sense is clear. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: the "Vibe" and "ext" fragments, the "læviebtibus" word and the "xxviiii" numeral, which is hard to read in the print. The final line numbered 50 has no visible text. Right-hand strip of a page; the left portion is blank or cut off. Some marginal words are heavily worn; "Infalatarum" and "Ampronniani" and "Basillæ" are doubtful readings.
